back_translation: As fire kindles dry brushwood, as fire makes water boil — come down to make your name known to your adversaries, so that the nations will tremble before your face!
When you did awesome deeds that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains quaked before your face.
From of old no one has heard, no ear has listened, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts for those who wait for him.

You come to meet the one who joyfully does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry because we sinned — we have remained in those sins a long time; can we still be saved?
We have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a filthy garment. We all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us off like the wind.
No one calls on your name, no one rouses himself to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and handed us over into the grip of our own iniquity.
But now, O LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.
O LORD, do not be angry beyond measure; do not remember iniquity forever. Please look — we are all your people.
Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
Our holy and glorious house, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire, and everything we treasured has become a ruin.
O LORD, seeing all this, will you still restrain yourself? Will you keep silent and let us suffer beyond measure?
